title: 业务实现与应用交付
scope: 有限本机ProjectModel Web制品物化、构建、实际规则检查及新目录更新；通用业务命令、数据迁移和回滚保持设计。
implemented_scope: Python standard-library loopback server and independent generated artifacts; whole ProjectModel edit/check/save/load with actual finite checker, exact integers, version CAS, atomic single-file history retention and source/ownership manifests. Explicit new-directory updates preserve old releases and human files; incompatible data/rules or file hashes reject. No general CommandBinding, migration, automatic rollback/crash recovery, remote integration or background business.
